stem: What is the name of the 16th-century stepwell that the Archaeological Survey of india recently conserved in collaboration with the World Monuments Fund India?

options.label: d
options.text: More than one of the above

expl: Rajon ki Baoli, located in the Mehrauli Archaeological Park, Delhi, is a four-tiered stepwell built around 1506 CE during the reign of Sikandar Lodi. It is an excellent example of Lodi-period architecture and water-structure engineering. The Archaeological Survey of India, in collaboration with World Monuments Fund India and the TCS Foundation, has successfully completed the conservation of Rajon ki Baoli.

stem: Where was the last Kumbh Mela of the 20th century celebrated?
expl: The last Kumbh Mela of the 20th century was held in Haridwar in 1998. In India, apart from Haridwar, Kumbh Melas are also organized at three other places—Allahabad (now Prayagraj), Nashik, and Ujjain.

The Jantar-Mantar in Jaipur was built by Sawai Raja Jai Singh. It is located near the City Palace. The main instruments at the Jantar-Mantar observatory include Samrat Yantra, Ram Yantra, Rashi-Valaya Yantra, and Kapali Yantra, which accurately indicate the motion of the sun and the moon and the positions of stars. Notably, for research in astronomy and celestial science, Sawai Jai Singh built five observatories at Delhi, Mathura, Ujjain, Varanasi, and Jaipur, among which the Jaipur observatory is the largest and highly scientific in design.

stem: Who painted 'Bharat Mata', famous for its historical values?
expl: “Bharat Mata” is a painting painted in 1905 by the famous Indian painter Abanindranath Tagore (nephew of Nobel Prize-winning Rabindranath Tagore).

stem: In which country is the three-day Thadingyut Festival celebrated?
expl: The Thadingyut festival is celebrated in Myanmar. In Myanmar, this festival is celebrated as a festival of lights. It is a prestigious cultural and religious festival. This festival is the second most popular festival in Myanmar after the Thingyan festival. It lasts for three days, which include the day before the full moon, the day of the full moon, and the day after the full moon.

stem: Which of the following states celebrates the Gangaur festival?
expl: Among the given options, the Gangaur festival is celebrated in Rajasthan. It falls on the Tritiya (third day) of the Shukla Paksha in the month of Chaitra. On this day, girls and women worship Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati.

stem:
Consider the following statements regarding Hoysala art:
1. The Hoysala style (1050-1300 AD) developed in the southern region of Karnataka.
2. The beginning of Hoysala art can be traced to the early Chalukya temples in Aihole, Badami, and Pattadakal.
3. An important monument employing this art is the Keshava Temple located in Belur.
4. Besides the architectural plan, the Hoysala style acquired some more specific characteristics. For example,chloritic schist was abandoned due to the more readily available sandstone.
Which of the statement/statements given above is/are correct?
expl: 1. The Hoysala style (1050–1300 AD) developed in the southern region of Karnataka; therefore statement 1 is correct. 2. The beginning of Hoysala art can be traced to the Early Chalukya temples at Aihole, Badami and Pattadakal; statement 2 is also correct. 3. An important monument employing this art is the Keshava Temple at Belur; statement 3 is also correct. 4. Hoysala temples are richly ornamented, and soapstone was used extensively. Since soapstone is softer and more suitable for carving than sandstone, statement 4 is incorrect.

expl: The Pushkar fair is organized in Ajmer district of Rajasthan, at Pushkar. The famous temple of Lord Brahma is also located at Pushkar, and Pushkar is also known for Jain pilgrimage sites. stem: Which of the following temples is located in Kanchipuram?
expl: Ekambareswarar Temple is located in Kanchipuram. This temple is dedicated to Lord Shiva. The construction of this temple was carried out by the Pallavas. Notably, this temple is thousands of years old, and it was reconstructed by the Pallavas around the 7th century CE. Later, the Vijayanagara rulers also contributed to the construction of this temple.

stem: Which of the following is a classical dance form of the state of Assam?
expl: Assam’s classical dance is Sattriya. This dance form is devotional in nature because its purpose was to propagate Neo-Vaishnavism. It was introduced by the great Vaishnav saint of Assam and reformer, Mahapurush Srimanta Shankaradeva. It is one of India’s eight classical dances.

stem: The 'Statue of Liberty' is located in-
expl: The 'Statue of Liberty' was made in France. The sculptor of the Statue of Liberty was Frédéric Auguste Bartholdi. The architect of the pedestal on which it is installed was Richard Morris Hunt, and the engineer of the internal framework was Alexandre Gustave Eiffel. As a symbol of France–America friendship, France gifted the Statue of Liberty to the United States on 28 October 1886, on the occasion of the centenary of American independence. This statue is located on Liberty Island in New York Harbor.
